ranked_facts.why: The presence of a high serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre is strongly indicative of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder, which cannot be explained by Multiple Sclerosis, Neoplastic Disease, Infectious/Inflammatory Disease, Vascular Disease, or Other candidates.

The persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid oligoclonal bands are more characteristic of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder than Multiple Sclerosis, which typically presents with positive oligoclonal bands, and does not support Neoplastic Disease, Infectious/Inflammatory Disease, Vascular Disease, or Other candidates.
